name: particles
title: Particles
description: Faint dots drifting very slowly across the frame and leaning toward a pointer: a quiet dust layer for dark hero frames.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.particles(q(".mw-particles"), tl, 0, { quantity: 300, size: 1.2, vx: 0.25, vy: -0.15, staticity: 30, pointer: [[0, -600, -200], [3.5, 600, 250], [7, -300, 300]], hold: 7 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Without a pointer it is near-static dust, as upstream. `pointer` lists [t, x, y] points (px from the centre of the box), linear between them.
